grammar_focus: 过去完成时(had done,背景先于过去动作)、过去分词短语作状语(Dressed as…/Faced with…/compared with…)、现在分词短语作状语(Living…/harrying…)、before/while/until 引导的时间状语从句、make/keep/find + 名词 + 形容词(a season of comfort had made them soft)(NCE4 无 KS 页,考点由课文结构自取;IP:源为伯纳德·纽曼署名版权散文,已换原创虚构国王 Aldric 与袭掠者、100% 原创行文,只承载语法/词表/话题/篇幅;题材=古代君王亲自扮吟游诗人潜入敌营侦察·无害;美语化 traveled/neighbor;第四册第9课)
scene: 阿尔德里克王决定亲自当自己的间谍。他装扮成一名流浪的吟游诗人,大摇大摆地走进侵占了他海岸的袭掠者营地——那年头,四处卖唱的歌手到哪儿都受欢迎;这种人不是兵,他们的歌就是通行证。阿尔德里克少年时学过几十首古老的民谣,还能靠几手杂耍和一点简单的戏法,把任何一个夜晚点亮。趁自己那支小军队还在沼泽地里集结,国王悄悄潜入敌人过冬营地的中心。他一眼就看出纪律已经松弛。袭掠者带着从未打过败仗的征服者那种轻松自信,岗哨也守得马马虎虎。他们已在寒冬里安顿下来,靠从周围村庄抢来的一切过着好日子,一季的安逸把他们养软了。阿尔德里克在他们中间待了一周才回到沼泽地。他在那儿集结的兵力,和敌军相比小得可怜,可他已探得一件无价的情报:袭掠者再也经不起一场持久的战役,他们的补给毫无章法,只靠零散劫掠。于是,面对敌人缓慢的推进,阿尔德里克没有去冒险打一场大仗。他让部下始终在移动,不停骚扰敌人、切断他们的觅食小队,直到饥饿替他把活儿干完。不出一个月,那些被拖垮、饿慌了的入侵者投降了——整桩事称得上一部小小的王室谍报史诗。

grammar_card.title: 过去完成时 / 分词作状语 / 时间状语从句 / make+名词+形容词
grammar_card.intro: ①过去完成时 had + 过去分词,表“过去的过去”(背景):discipline had grown slack。②过去分词短语作状语,表被动/完成:Dressed as a minstrel…；Faced with the advance…；compared with the host。③现在分词短语作状语,表主动/伴随:Living well on stolen food…；harrying the enemy…。④时间连词 before/while/until 引导从句。⑤make/keep/find + 名词 + 形容词:had made them soft。

rows: Dressed as a minstrel, he entered
harrying the enemy, he moved on

specialRules.rule: 过去完成时=had + 过去分词,主语不分单复数都用 had;表示比另一个过去动作更早发生。
过去分词短语作状语=被动或已完成(Dressed as…=被装扮成);现在分词短语作状语=主动或正在进行(Living…=正过着)。
美式拼写:traveled(旅行,英式 travelled)、neighbor(邻居,英式 neighbour)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What important thing did King Aldric learn when he entered the enemy camp?
options: That the raiders' discipline was slack and they could not fight a long war
That the raiders had more soldiers
That the raiders wanted to make peace
That the raiders had already left

passage: King Aldric chose to act as his own spy. Dressed as a wandering minstrel, he walked freely into the camps of the raiders who had overrun his coast, for in those days a traveling minstrel was welcomed everywhere; such men were not soldiers, and their songs were their passport. Aldric had learned dozens of old ballads in his boyhood, and he could brighten any evening with a few acrobatic tricks and a little simple conjuring. While his own small army was still gathering in the marshes, the king slipped into the heart of the enemy's winter camp. He noticed at once that discipline had grown slack. The raiders had the easy confidence of conquerors who had never been beaten, and their guards kept watch carelessly. They had settled in for the cold months, living well on all that they had seized from the villages around, and a season of comfort had made them soft. Aldric stayed among them for a week before he returned to his marshes. The force he had gathered there was tiny compared with the enemy host, yet he had deduced something priceless: the raiders were no longer fit for a prolonged campaign, and their supplies had no real order but depended on scattered plunder. So, faced with the enemy's slow advance, Aldric did not risk one great battle. Instead he kept his men always on the move, harrying the enemy and cutting off their foraging parties until hunger did his work for him. Within a single month the invaders, worn down and starving, had surrendered — and the whole episode could fairly be called a small epic of royal espionage.

stage5.stem: "The raiders ___ overrun his coast before he came."(过去完成时,填助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 在他来之前,袭掠者已侵占了他的海岸。

stage5.stem: "By spring the invaders ___ already surrendered."(过去完成时,填助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 到春天,入侵者已经投降了。

stage5.stem: "Discipline had ___ slack over the winter."(过去完成 had + 过去分词;grow 的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 一冬下来纪律已变得松弛。

stage5.stem: "___ as a wandering minstrel, the king entered the camp."(过去分词作状语,‘打扮成…’;dress 的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 装扮成流浪歌手,国王走进了营地。

stage5.stem: "___ with the enemy's advance, he chose not to fight."(过去分词作状语,‘面对…’;face 的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 面对敌人的推进,他选择不正面交战。

stage5.stem: "His force was tiny ___ with the enemy host."(过去分词短语,‘与…相比’)
stage5.stem_cn: 与敌军相比,他的部队小得可怜。

stage5.stem: "___ well on stolen food, the raiders grew careless."(现在分词作状语,主动‘靠…生活’;live 的 -ing)
stage5.stem_cn: 靠抢来的粮食过着好日子,袭掠者变得松懈。

stage5.stem: "He kept his men moving, ___ the enemy day and night."(现在分词作状语,主动‘骚扰’)
stage5.stem_cn: 他让部下不停移动,日夜骚扰敌人。

stage5.stem: "The king slipped in, ___ every weakness of the camp."(现在分词作状语,主动‘注意到’)
stage5.stem_cn: 国王潜入,留意着营地的每一处弱点。

stage5.stem: "He stayed a week ___ he returned to the marshes."(‘在…之前’,填时间连词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他待了一周才回到沼泽地。

stage5.stem: "___ his army was gathering, the king went spying."(‘当…的时候’,填时间连词)
stage5.stem_cn: 当他的军队集结时,国王去做间谍。

stage5.stem: "He did not attack ___ his men were ready."(‘直到…才’,填时间连词)
stage5.stem_cn: 不到部下准备就绪,他不发动进攻。

stage5.stem: "A season of comfort had made them ___."(make + 名词 + 形容词;填形容词)
stage5.stem_cn: 一季的安逸把他们养软了。

stage5.stem: "The king found the camp poorly ___."(find + 名词 + 过去分词‘被…’;guard 的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 国王发现营地守卫松懈。

stage5.stem: "Constant raids kept the enemy ___ and tired."(keep + 名词 + 形容词;填形容词)
stage5.stem_cn: 不断的袭扰使敌人又饿又疲。

stage5.stem: "A person who wanders singing from place to place is a ___."(“流浪歌手/吟游诗人”用哪个词)
"Secret watching to gather an enemy's plans is ___."(“谍报/间谍活动”用哪个词)
"A war or effort that lasts a long time is ___."(“持久的、长时间的”用哪个词)
